PE1-03.hint: To change degrees to radians multiply by \(\dfrac{\pi}{180\text{°}}\). To change radians to degrees multiply by \(\dfrac{180\text{°}}{\pi}\). Reduce the fraction.
slips: Using the conversion factor upside down. Check the answer: \(165\text{°}\) is a bit less than a half turn, so its radian measure should be a bit less than \(\pi\).
Leaving \(\pi\) in a degree answer. When you convert from radians, the \(\pi\) cancels.
